purpose: Back-facing explorer in the Initiation world
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one original transparent PNG character sprite for the foreground of a pixel-art fantasy exploration website.
Primary request: Create ONE full-body explorer seen directly from behind, standing still and looking away into the distance. The asset is the person alone, isolated on a genuinely transparent alpha background.
Subject: gender-neutral adult explorer with natural adult proportions, short dark tousled hair seen only from the back, a navy outdoor jacket, a cobalt-blue practical backpack, dark trousers and worn brown hiking boots. Quiet upright stance, both feet planted and visibly separated, arms relaxed down, hands empty. The whole head, backpack, hands and both boots must be visible.
Style/medium: detailed premium pixel art, 16-bit to 32-bit adventure game aesthetic, deliberate hard-edged square pixel clusters, restrained palette, subtle dithering, crisp silhouette. Match a richly detailed pixel-art fantasy world of blue-black floating gothic ruins and a cyan portal at night, or a lavender-and-gold fantasy city at dusk. The character must still read clearly when reduced to approximately 150–250 pixels tall.
Composition/framing: centered full-body character, portrait 2:3 canvas, generous transparent margins on every side. Direct rear view at eye level; shoulders squared away from viewer and gaze straight toward horizon. No face or profile visible. Calm contemplative presence.
Lighting/mood: subtle cyan edge lighting with a restrained warm amber rim accent, predominantly dark navy and cobalt materials, enough muted midtone detail to work against both a dark night scene and warm dusk scene. No luminous halo or external glow.
Scene/backdrop: fully transparent, alpha zero everywhere outside the character silhouette, including between the legs. No background color and no rectangular backdrop. Do not draw a checkerboard; transparency must be real in the PNG.
Constraints: one original explorer only; no scenery, floor, ground plane, rock, platform, cast shadow, props beyond worn clothing and backpack, weapons, staff, text, numbers, logos, watermark, border, front view, side view, other characters, or sprite sheet.
changes: Trimmed transparent margins, resized to 720px height and converted to lossless WebP with alpha preserved.
